strings.name: Yo-Yo Ma
strings.summary: Born in Paris, Ma learned cello in childhood, then pursued musical training and liberal-arts education in the United States. His work spans Bach, contemporary music, tango and folk traditions. Silkroad and the Bach Project connect traditions and communities. A UN Messenger of Peace, he uses music for public exchange through sustained collaboration with performers, composers and local partners.
